articles.title: Trump, Putin To Hold Bilateral Talks On November 19 Ahead Of First-Ever Trilateral Summit With China's Xi
articles.description: US President Donald Trump will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin on November 19 in Shenzhen, ahead of a historic trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The leaders are expected to discuss nuclear disarmament, Iran, the Russia-Ukraine war and global trade, amid growing diplomatic engagements between the three major powers at the APEC summit in China.

articles.title: Trump plans separate talks with Putin alongside their summit with Xi in China
articles.description: The president’s meeting with Putin would be the first time the leaders have held talks since their discussions last year in Alaska that failed to broker a deal to ease Russia’s war in Ukraine.

articles.title: Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner expected in Berlin for Ukraine talks, says US
articles.description: WASHINGTON, Nov 18 - US diplomatic envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected in Berlin on Thursday to meet Ukrainian officials and a European negotiating team as they ramp up efforts to end Russia's war in Ukraine, a US official said on Wednesday. Read more at straitstimes.com.

articles.title: Europe Tonight: Eurozone growth forecast at 1.2%, Ukraine strikes Crimea bridge
articles.description: The EU forecasts 1.2% Eurozone growth amid inflation and debt concerns, analysed live tonight by Valdis Dombrovskis. Meanwhile, Ukraine strikes a key Russia-Crimea bridge ahead of talks with Norway's Foreign Minister, and Spain's Pedro Sánchez slams EU Rwanda asylum plans.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine hit key bridges as trilateral talks near
articles.description: KYIV — Russia hit two major bridges in Kyiv while Ukraine struck Moscow’s link to annexed Crimea for the second night in a row, officials said Tuesday, ahead of a meeting of Chinese, US and Russian leaders.

articles.title: Russia opposes separate Black Sea deal without a peace agreement, Turkish FM says
articles.description: Russia does not want to reach an interim agreement with Ukraine on the Black Sea without a comprehensive peace deal. Turkey is working on proposals to facilitate an agreement and discussing them with both the Ukrainian and Russian sides. — Ukrinform.

articles.title: After peace talks snub, Kallas faces reproach and uncertain future
articles.description: The glaring exclusion of High Representative Kaja Kallas from the Ukraine-Russia peace talks has raised uncomfortable questions about the relevance of her job. Defiant but isolated, Kallas stands by her words. After peace talks snub, Kallas faces reproach and uncertain future

articles.title: “Talk to Putin”: Finland Challenges Europe as Fears Grow Over a New Yalta and a Trump-Russia Deal
articles.description: Finnish President Alexander Stubb urges European leaders to engage directly with Vladimir Putin, warning that Europe risks being sidelined as Washington shapes negotiations over Ukraine. From Donbas and NATO membership to the continent’s future security architecture, the stakes extend far beyond the battlefield. “Talk to Putin”: Finland Challenges Europe as Fears Grow Over a New Yalta and a Trump-Russia Deal
